overview.activate.title: Activate your company
overview.activate.lead: Your company starts empty: no department, no employee, no mission, no CEO. Activating it needs one AI connection of your account that Orbit Web can use — for a chat, research or an AI employee.
overview.activate.nameHint: From Settings → Account; change it here if you like.
overview.activate.connectionsAria: What your AI connections can be used for
overview.activate.noConnection: No AI connection yet. Connect Claude Code or OpenAI Codex first.
overview.activate.runsNothing: Orbit Web runs nothing on {runtime} yet.
overview.emptyBody: Add a department or hire your first AI employee to organize the office.
overview.connectCliFirst: Connect an AI CLI first: hiring needs one connected CLI whose models were read from your account.

sources.noSources: This workspace has no source yet.
hire.claudePlanQuote: Advertised usage limits for Pro, Max, and Ultra plans assume ordinary, individual usage of Claude Code and the Agent SDK.
hire.sandboxPrepared: Its Personal Sandbox is prepared first (its desk, toolbox and quotas; no container starts), and it takes work once that is ready.
hire.availabilityUnknown: {sandbox} Whether its work could start at once is not known: the account's budget could not be read.
hire.availabilityNever: {sandbox} As configured its work could never start: it needs {needs}, above the account's budget ({budgetCpu}, {budgetMemory}) or what this host can give.
hire.availabilityNow: {sandbox} Its work could start at once: it needs {needs}, and that is free now.
hire.availabilityWait: {sandbox} Its work would wait for resources: it needs {needs}; {freeCpu} and {freeMemory} are free now. It is hired all the same.

hire.templateHint: Optional: fills the role, which you can change.
hire.handoffHint: Optional: what every result it hands in must hold.
hire.teamLeadLabel: Team lead: may give parts of its work to colleagues
hire.teamLeadDesc: A team lead splits an assignment into parts for other employees of the office, shares a team room with them for that mission, reviews each part as it is handed in, and hands the whole in to you. Its colleagues need no switch.
hire.connectionHint: Only a connection that is connected, with its models read from your account, can run an employee.
hire.connectInSettings: Connect one in Settings → AI Connections
hire.effortNoLevelHint: This model takes no effort level.
hire.webSearchOff: Web search: not offered — this connection's CLI has no search Orbit can switch ({why}).

hire.pluginSettingsLink: Settings → AI Connections → Claude Code → Plugins
hire.teamLeadYes: Yes: may give parts of its work to colleagues
hire.limitsSummary: scratch {scratch}, cache {cache}, {pids} processes, {timeout} minutes per attempt
hire.subscriptionClaudeHint: An API key is recommended for an employee that works on its own.

mission.repin.means: Its next attempt runs on {name}'s profile as it is now — the connection, model and effort in effect today — instead of the one pinned when the work was claimed. Its brief, answers, revisions and hand-ins carry over.

mission.shareHandoffFull: The hand-in of part “{unit}”, in full

leadership.title: Leadership
leadership.sub: Authority comes from an appointment, never from a title or the team-lead switch.
leadership.noCeo: No CEO yet — a company works without one
appointment.means.appoint: An appointment is the company's authority: a title or the team-lead switch grants none. Only an employee on trial or active, who holds no other appointment, is appointed.
appointment.means.appointManager: A manager is a member of the department it manages: only {department}'s own members are offered.
appointment.means.replace: {name}'s appointment ends as replaced and the next one starts at once, so the slot is never empty. Open work {name} holds stays with them until a person hands it over.
appointment.means.suspend: {name} keeps the slot and acts for nothing until reinstated.
appointment.means.revoke: The slot is left empty; the appointment stays in its history.
appointment.ceoLeaves: {name} leaves {department}: the CEO belongs to no department.
appointment.noCandidate: Nobody can be appointed now: only an employee on trial or active is.
appointment.noMember: No member of {department} can be appointed: move an employee on trial or active into it first.
appointment.stale: This appointment changed since the page read it: nothing was done. Close this and try again.
defaults.companyLead: What an employee runs on where its profile — and its department — leave the connection, model or effort to the company. A default of one runtime never applies to another: nothing switches an employee's provider. Work already claimed keeps what it pinned.
defaults.departmentLead: What {name}'s employees run on where their profile leaves the connection, model or effort to the department; a field not set here is left to the company's default. Work already claimed keeps what it pinned.
defaults.noRuntime: No AI connection of this account can run employees yet.
defaults.stale: The defaults changed since the page read them: nothing was saved. Close this and try again.
employee.authoritySub: Its appointment: the company's authority, as CEO or as a department's manager.
employee.noAppointment: No appointment: a title or a team-lead switch grants none.
employee.fromDefaults: Its department's, else the company's default
employee.defaultModelNote: its department's (else the company's) default model
delegation.title: May give work to (without an appointment)
delegation.sub: A delegation grant lets an employee who holds no appointment give work to named colleagues, or to a department's members. A title or the team-lead switch grants none.
delegation.empty: No grant: without an appointment it gives work to nobody.
hire.inheritLabel: Use the department's (else the company's) default model and effort
hire.inheritNote: It keeps this connection; its model and effort follow the defaults, so a default changed later applies to its later work.
hire.noModelDefault: none named for {runtime} — set a department or company default, or choose a model here: until then it is refused
hire.modelNotOffered: This connection does not offer {value}: it would be refused.
hire.effortRequired: {model} takes an effort level: name a default effort, or choose one here — until then it is refused.
